description:
Extend dense $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ row reduction with an ordered-column preference and the row-operation transform needed by matrix and syndrome callers.

## Background

`gf2_core::alg::rref` exposes directional pivoting but cannot consume an explicit preference permutation or apply the same row operations to a right-hand side. The reusable primitive remains independent of coding and LLR policy.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Accepts a complete ordered column preference and returns the reduced matrix, selected independent columns in preference order, rank, and applied row transform.
- [hard] REQ-02: Applies the returned transform to a conforming right-hand side so $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}$ is equivalent to $(\mathbf{U}\mathbf{A})\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{U}\mathbf{b}$.
- [hard] REQ-03: Handles rank-deficient, empty, and rectangular matrices deterministically and identifies inconsistent transformed right-hand sides outside the reachable row space.
- [hard] REQ-04: Rejects malformed preference permutations and right-hand-side dimensions through documented public errors.
- [hard] REQ-05: Matches existing RREF rank and row-space semantics under natural and reversed column orders.
title: Ordered-column elimination transform
